# Shagun Khemka

> Senior Software Engineer (Backend) at JioHotstar, Bengaluru, India. Builds high-scale subscription platforms and production AI systems: LLM routing, evals and cost-aware inference.

## Experience
- JioHotstar, Senior Software Engineer, Backend (2024–now): subscriptions platform for 280M+ users; architected the P0 entitlement read path at ~50K RPS; re-architected purchase and upgrade flows (~20% revenue growth, Astral Team Award); led the migration of 14M+ JioCinema subscribers.
- FamPay (YC S19), Software Engineer, Backend (2020–2024): led a team of four on the FamCard platform (5M+ cards); built products behind ~60% of company revenue.
- Instamojo, Software Engineer, Backend (2019–2020): merchant onboarding automation and reseller product ingestion.

## Projects
- Document extraction platform: LLM pipeline for a logistics ERP software company. Field-level evals across Claude, GPT, Gemini, Qwen, Mistral and Sarvam choose the production model; Gemini 3.8 Flash and GPT-6 Luna run in production with a phased per-tenant rollout. On the latest eval GPT-6 Luna is 8x cheaper and ~45% faster than Gemini Flash, with total amount, invoice value and actual weight at 100%.
- ConsumerBuddy (https://consumerbuddy.in): AI drafting of consumer-court complaints in India, with per-cohort model routing and cost controls.
